picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new federal push to embed AI directly into national scientific infrastructure, from particle physics data streams to broader discovery pipelines.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20m MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge combining stem-cell tissue models with AI could meaningfully shorten drug development timelines, a concrete step toward AI-accelerated medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM system, built with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida, shows AI moving into life-critical clinical procedures like blood draws and intubation, a tangible cross-institutional healthcare partnership.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang using generative AI to design entirely new proteins not found in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's methods, represents a genuine scientific frontier with major biomedical potential.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky winning the 2026 Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics work underpinning modern AI theory, a top-tier international honor for the field.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's DOE Genesis Mission funding to apply AI to quantum error correction and national-lab data sharing extends the federal AI-for-science initiative into critical infrastructure problems.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability, a standard-setting contribution likely to shape the field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE Genesis Mission award with Fermilab to build AI tools for sifting high-energy physics data shows the initiative reaching into fundamental physics research at national labs.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A URI-founded startup, FastFlowLM, joining AMD to optimize NPU usage for large language models is a concrete academia-to-industry pipeline with direct commercial stakes in AI hardware.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Tsinghua's GeoPT pretraining approach, teaching AI models physical intuition from efficient simulations, addresses a core limitation in how AI systems reason about the real world.
picks.title: With a feel for physics, AI models simulate a wider range of real-world scenarios
